description: Get a market snapshot for a ZIP code: homes for sale (active and coming soon) with the median asking price and median price per square foot, overall and by property type; rentals with the median monthly rent; sales in the last 12 months with the median sale price where sale prices are public; and the number of off-market homes. Use this for market-level questions like 'how's the market in 90210?' or 'how many homes are for sale in 78704?'
name: get_market_stats
title: ZIP market stats
